visual_events.label: Scooping and applying first batch of mortar along brick-on-edge rails
visual_events.description: In a static shot, ent_mason_right bends over ent_mortar_pan at 0.0s, scoops wet grey mortar with his trowel (0.0s–1.8s), and places and spreads it along the top outer and inner brick edges of the long leg of ent_wall (1.8s–6.2s), using his left hand on the inner side to guide the mortar and keep it on the narrow brick edge next to the open cavity. Meanwhile, ent_mason_center squats at the far corner of ent_wall, using his trowel to trim and smooth mortar along the top of the short transverse wall section (0.0s–4.8s), then pauses holding his trowel and watches ent_mason_right (4.8s–6.2s).
visual_events.context_result: A bed of wet grey mortar is spread along the top edges of one cavity section of the brick-on-edge course without filling the adjacent open rectangular cavities.
visual_events.camera_framing: Static medium-wide shot angled down along the length of the low L-shaped brick wall.

visual_events.label: Scooping second batch of mortar and carefully shaping mortar bed with hand guard over cavities
visual_events.description: ent_mason_right bends down to ent_mortar_pan, mixes and scoops a second trowel-load of wet grey mortar (6.2s–8.0s), applies it to the top brick edges of ent_wall just further along the course (8.0s–11.0s), and repeatedly shapes, bevels, and smooths the mortar bed along the narrow top edges using the trowel in his right hand while holding his left hand/fingers against the brick edge and cavity opening to prevent mortar from dropping into the hollow cavities (11.0s–22.4s). At 16.5s–17.6s, ent_mason_right briefly reaches down with his right hand to pick up a small bit from the pan/ground before resuming trowel shaping. Meanwhile, ent_mason_center briefly touches the far wall corner with his trowel (9.5s–11.5s) and otherwise remains squatting and watching.
visual_events.context_result: The mortar bed on the narrow brick-on-edge course is neatly shaped and beveled while the adjacent hollow cavities remain visibly open.

visual_events.label: Scooping third batch of mortar and applying to next brick-on-edge section
visual_events.description: ent_mason_right bends down to ent_mortar_pan again, scrapes and scoops a third load of wet mortar onto his trowel (22.4s–24.8s), and begins placing it onto the next top brick edge of ent_wall (24.8s–25.92s) while ent_mason_center leans forward and touches the far wall edge with his trowel (23.8s–25.92s). The action is ongoing when the clip ends at 25.92s.
visual_events.context_result: Third mortar application is in progress and cut off by the end of the recording.

interpretations.uncertainty: The low L-shaped structure on bare sandy ground appears to be a low demonstration or training wall rather than a full multi-storey house foundation, though the brick-on-edge bond pattern and hollow cavities are directly visible.

interpretations.claim: The foreground mason uses his left hand alongside the trowel to cup and guide the wet mortar along the narrow brick-on-edge rails, illustrating how masons control mortar placement to avoid dropping mortar into the open internal cavities.
interpretations.uncertainty: Whether zero mortar particles fell into the cavities is not measurable from the camera angle, and thermal insulating performance itself is an inferred physical property not directly visible.

world_markers.observation: The foreground mason (ent_mason_right) wears a tan short-sleeved collared shirt with a pen in the chest pocket, dark grey trousers, and black open-toe sandals without hard hat or gloves.
The second mason (ent_mason_center) wears a light-coloured long-sleeved collared shirt with a pen in the chest pocket, grey trousers, and dark sandals.

Both masons use pointed metal masonry trowels with wooden handles, and wet grey mortar is held in a round bowl-shaped metal head pan (tasla) resting on the ground; a long aluminium straightedge/level bar and a wooden piece lie on the ground to the left of the wall.
The low three-course L-shaped wall is built from unplastered red-orange rectangular bricks laid on edge with wet dark-grey mortar joints and open rectangular interior cavities.
The work takes place outdoors on flat, reddish-tan sandy soil shaded by mature green trees, with a two-storey terracotta-coloured building partially visible in the background.
Two motorcycles and a wooden handcart near a large black cylindrical water tank are parked in the background left, and a white compact SUV is parked under the trees in the background center.
